S.FORM: alang Angcoh ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Buri go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 64 buwan, 154 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 148 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 6 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 95%, Bunun 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Angcoh hya' ga rgyax. tay 'zil na Angcoh hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Angcoh hya' ga rgyax. tay mkraya' na Angcoh hya' ga rgyax. tay mkraya' na Angcoh hya' ga Namisan. tay mkyahu' na Angcoh hya' ga Harawan. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Angcoh ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu βuri ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βunun * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj ʔzil na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkrajaʔ na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkrajaʔ na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa nami[s|ɕ]an taj mkjaħuʔ na aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa ħarawan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
